pve_api_url.description: Full API base URL of your Proxmox VE cluster (e.g., https://pve.example.com:8006/api2/json). Must include scheme, hostname, port, and path.

api_token_id.description: Proxmox VE API token ID in 'user!tokenid' format (e.g., fenceagent!pve). Must have 'Sys.Audit' and 'VM.Audit' privileges.

api_token_secret.description: Secret key for the API token. Never commit this value to version control.

verify_ssl.description: Whether to validate Proxmox VE's SSL certificate. Set to false only in secure/test environments with self-signed certs.

cacert.description: Absolute path to a custom CA certificate bundle (PEM format) for SSL verification. Leave empty to use system trust store.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for API responses before timing out. Increase for large clusters or high latency.

nodes.description: List of nodes to register for fencing. Required only when automatic discovery is disabled (rare).

hostname.description: Proxmox VE node hostname (must resolve from all cluster members).
